title: Optimizing injection tokens
description: Learn how lightweight injection tokens help Angular tree-shake unused component and service implementations in production builds.

blocks.text: When you use a component class as an injection token, the compiler retains a reference to that class implementation. This prevents the tree-shaker from dropping unused component definitions from production bundles. Lightweight injection tokens solve this problem.
